question: Can one frozen DepthART encoder learn metric depth, support, obstacle evidence and continuous source-boundary factors from the R10 package without complete truth?

input.split: 12 FIT / 2 SELECTION / 2 CANARY parents; pre-existing consumed TRAIN development roles

loader_correction.problem: The previous trainer reused obstacle evidence validity for boundary losses.
loader_correction.resolution: Boundary now consumes boundary_factor_valid_hw, boundary_quality_tier_hw and boundary_soft_probability_hw; obstacle keeps evidence_truth_valid_hw/evidence_quality_tier_hw.
loader_correction.unknown_policy: Each factor uses its own mask; UNKNOWN never becomes negative.

fixed_model.head: factor-split dilated 1/2/4 trunks
fixed_model.objective: depth/support/obstacle dense losses plus continuous boundary heat, near-distance and heat-distance consistency

interpretation.supported: The R10 package supports simultaneous parent-held-out depth, support, obstacle and near-boundary learning signals.
interpretation.unsupported: The full boundary distance field is not calibrated and metric depth remains far from task-ready at the 0.10 m threshold.
interpretation.architecture_finding: Boundary requires both a factor-specific trunk and its continuous near-field objective; a trunk split alone is insufficient.
interpretation.freshness: This is an internal consumed-TRAIN development comparison, not fresh-source proof.

decision.next_execution: Evaluate the frozen checkpoint on external source-native depth/boundary evidence without fitting or threshold selection.

claim_boundary: Consumed-TRAIN WILD_LAB unified factor learnability and ablation evidence only. This is not complete truth, fresh-source generalization, task utility, formal F1 authorization, safety, deployment, or product evidence.
